title: Wembanyama Posts 52 Points, 24 Rebounds and 8 Blocks in Spurs Win Over Mavericks
dek: The Spurs forward became the first player since 1974 with at least 50 points, 20 rebounds and five blocks in a game, in a 112-111 win in San Antonio.
author: Meridian Newsroom
keyPoints: Victor Wembanyama finished with career highs of 52 points and 24 rebounds, plus eight blocks, in the Spurs' 112-111 win over the Dallas Mavericks on Wednesday, Nov. 4, Yahoo Sports reported.
Yahoo Sports reported he became the first player since Bob McAdoo on Feb. 22, 1974 to finish a game with at least 50 points, 20 rebounds and five blocks.
Wembanyama went 16-of-28 from the field and 15-for-15 from the free-throw line in the first half, per Yahoo Sports and Yahoo Sports also reported a 25-point, 15-rebound, five-block first half.
Through the first eight games of the 2026-27 season, he is averaging 29.0 points, 12.4 rebounds and 4.5 blocks per game, Yahoo Sports reported.
body:
Victor Wembanyama produced one of the most unusual stat lines in recent NBA history on Wednesday, leading the San Antonio Spurs to a 112-111 win over the Dallas Mavericks at Frost Bank Center.

## The line

Wembanyama, 22, finished with 52 points on 16-of-28 shooting, 24 rebounds and eight blocks, according to Yahoo Sports and Heavy. Yahoo Sports reported he became the first player since Bob McAdoo, on Feb. 22, 1974, to record at least 50 points, 20 rebounds and five blocks in one game.

## Other records

Yahoo Sports reported he also became the first player in NBA history with at least 25 points, 15 rebounds and five blocks in a single half, and the first since Wilt Chamberlain in 1964 to post at least 50 points and 20 rebounds in a one-point victory. Yahoo Sports reported he became just the fifth player in NBA history to record multiple 50-point games at age 22 or younger.

He went 15-for-15 from the free-throw line in the first half, tying James Harden for the most first-half free throws made without a miss in the play-by-play era, which dates to 1997-98, Yahoo Sports reported. Heavy described the performance as joining an exclusive company of players with historic nights.

## Season context

Through eight games this season, Wembanyama is averaging career highs of 29.0 points, 12.4 rebounds and 4.5 blocks per game, Yahoo Sports reported. He is the reigning NBA Defensive Player of the Year and the 2024 Rookie of the Year. The Big Lead framed the performance as the first feat of its kind since 1974.

## What to watch

The Spurs have not yet published a team statement on the performance in the coverage reviewed for this story. Meridian will update this story with any official league correction, additional box-score detail or a formal record confirmation from the NBA.
